aboutDataSource: This is a test app. The observations, photos and species data all come from iNaturalist.
aboutDescription: A memory game for species: pick a place and practice its species until you recognize them.
deleteCategoryWarning: "{{name}}" will be removed from every species tagged with it, and from any filter using it. This cannot be undone.
geolocationNotSupported: Geolocation is not supported by your browser
installHelp.androidChromiumStep2: Choose "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
installHelp.androidChromiumStep3: Confirm to place the icon on your home screen.
installHelp.desktopChromiumStep1: Click the install icon on the right side of the address bar.
installHelp.desktopChromiumStep2: If you do not see it, open the browser menu and look for "Install" or "Cast, save and share".
installHelp.desktopFirefoxNote: Firefox on the desktop cannot install web apps, but the app still works normally in a tab.
installHelp.desktopFirefoxStep1: Open this page in Chrome or Edge to install it as an app.
installHelp.desktopFirefoxStep2: Or keep it here as a bookmark or a pinned tab.
installHelp.intro: Your browser does not offer a one-tap install, but you can still add the app yourself. It will open in its own window and keep working offline.
installHelp.iosOtherBrowserNote: On iPhone and iPad, Safari is the browser that handles this best.
installHelp.iosOtherBrowserStep1: Open the Share menu and look for "Add to Home Screen".
installHelp.iosOtherBrowserStep2: If it is missing, open this page in Safari and try again from there.
installHelp.iosSafariStep1: Tap the Share button at the bottom of Safari.
installHelp.iosSafariStep2: Scroll down and choose "Add to Home Screen".
installHelp.title: Add to your home screen
installHelp.unknownStep1: Open your browser menu and look for "Install app" or "Add to Home screen".
installHelp.unknownStep2: If there is no such option, open this page in Chrome, Edge or Safari.
